TOPSYTURVY.description: All stat changes affecting the target turn topsy-turvy and become the opposite of what they were.
TOPSYTURVY.name: Topsy-Turvy

TORMENT.description: The user torments the target, making it incapable of using the same move twice in a row.
TORMENT.name: Torment

TOXIC.description: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.
TOXIC.name: Toxic

TOXICSPIKES.description: The user lays a trap of poison spikes. They poison opponents that switch into battle.
TOXICSPIKES.name: Toxic Spikes

TOXICTHREAD.description: The user shoots poisonous threads to poison the target and lower their Speed stat.
TOXICTHREAD.name: Toxic Thread

TRANSFORM.description: The user transforms into a clone of its target.
TRANSFORM.name: Transform

TRIATTACK.description: The user strikes with a beam attack. May also burn, freeze, or paralyze.
TRIATTACK.name: Tri Attack

TRICK.description: The user catches the target off guard and swaps its held item with its own.
TRICK.name: Trick

TRICKORTREAT.description: The user adds Ghost type to the target's type.
TRICKORTREAT.name: Trick-or-Treat

TRICKROOM.description: The user creates a bizarre area in which slower Pokémon get to move first for five turns.
TRICKROOM.name: Trick Room

TRIPLEAXEL.description: A consecutive three-kick attack that becomes more powerful with each successful hit.
TRIPLEAXEL.name: Triple Axel

TRIPLEKICK.description: A consecutive three-kick attack that becomes more powerful with each successive hit.
TRIPLEKICK.name: Triple Kick

TROPKICK.description: The user lands an intense kick of tropical origins on the target, lowering their Attack.
TROPKICK.name: Trop Kick

TRUMPCARD.description: The fewer PP this move has, the greater its attack power.
TRUMPCARD.name: Trump Card

TWINEEDLE.description: The user damages the target twice by jabbing it with spikes. It may poison the target.
TWINEEDLE.name: Twineedle

TWINKLETACKLE.description: The user creates a very charming space using its Z-Power and totally toys with the target.
TWINKLETACKLE.name: Twinkle Tackle

TWISTER.description: The user whips up a tornado to tear at the opposing team. It may make targets flinch.
TWISTER.name: Twister

UPROAR.description: The user attacks in an uproar for three turns. No one can fall asleep.
UPROAR.name: Uproar

UTURN.description: After making its attack, the user switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting.
UTURN.name: U-turn

VACUUMWAVE.description: The user whirls its fists to send out a wave of pure vacuum. This move always goes first.
VACUUMWAVE.name: Vacuum Wave

VCREATE.description: With flames on its head, it hit target. It lowers its Defense, Sp. Def, and Speed stats.
VCREATE.name: V-create

VENOMDRENCH.description: Opposing Pokémon are drenched in an odd liquid. It lowers the Atk, Sp. Atk and Speed of a poisoned target.
VENOMDRENCH.name: Venom Drench

VENOSHOCK.description: The user drenches the target in a poison. Its power doubles if the target is poisoned.
VENOSHOCK.name: Venoshock

VICEGRIP.description: The target is gripped and squeezed from both sides to inflict damage.
VICEGRIP.name: Vise Grip

VINEWHIP.description: The target is struck with slender, whiplike vines to inflict damage.
VINEWHIP.name: Vine Whip

VITALTHROW.description: The user attacks last. In return, this throw move is guaranteed not to miss.
VITALTHROW.name: Vital Throw

VOLTSWITCH.description: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon.
VOLTSWITCH.name: Volt Switch

VOLTTACKLE.description: The user electrifies itself and charges. It damages the user and may paralyze the target.
VOLTTACKLE.name: Volt Tackle

WAKEUPSLAP.description: This attack inflicts big damage on a sleeping target. It also wakes the target up.
WAKEUPSLAP.name: Wake-Up Slap

WATERFALL.description: The user charges at the target and may make it flinch. It can also be used to climb a waterfall.
WATERFALL.name: Waterfall

WATERGUN.description: The target is blasted with a forceful shot of water.
WATERGUN.name: Water Gun

WATERPLEDGE.description: A column of water strikes the target. It can be combined with its fire equivalent.
WATERPLEDGE.name: Water Pledge

WATERPULSE.description: The user attacks the target with a pulsing blast of water. It may also confuse the target.
WATERPULSE.name: Water Pulse

WATERSHURIKEN.description: The target is hit with throwing stars two to five times. It always goes first.
WATERSHURIKEN.name: Water Shuriken

WATERSPORT.description: The user soaks itself with water. The move weakens Fire-type moves while the user is in the battle.
WATERSPORT.name: Water Sport

WATERSPOUT.description: The user spouts water to damage the opposing team. Damage varies with the user's HP.
WATERSPOUT.name: Water Spout

WEATHERBALL.description: An attack move that varies in power and type depending on the weather.
WEATHERBALL.name: Weather Ball

WEATHERBALLHAIL.description: An attack move that varies in power and type depending on the weather.
WEATHERBALLHAIL.name: Weather Ball ANIMATION

WEATHERBALLRAIN.description: An attack move that varies in power and type depending on the weather.
WEATHERBALLRAIN.name: Weather Ball ANIMATION

WEATHERBALLSAND.description: An attack move that varies in power and type depending on the weather.
WEATHERBALLSAND.name: Weather Ball ANIMATION

WEATHERBALLSUN.description: An attack move that varies in power and type depending on the weather.
WEATHERBALLSUN.name: Weather Ball ANIMATION

WHIRLPOOL.description: Traps foes in a violent swirling whirlpool for four to five turns.
WHIRLPOOL.name: Whirlpool

WHIRLWIND.description: The foe is blown away to be replaced by another Pokémon or flee.
WHIRLWIND.name: Whirlwind

WICKEDBLOW.description: The user, having mastered the Dark style, strikes the target with a fierce blow. This attack always results in a critical hit.
WICKEDBLOW.name: Wicked Blow

WIDEGUARD.description: The user and its allies are protected from wide-ranging attacks for one turn.
WIDEGUARD.name: Wide Guard

WILDCHARGE.description: The user shrouds itself in electricity and smashes into its target. It damages the user.
WILDCHARGE.name: Wild Charge

WILLOWISP.description: The user shoots a sinister, bluish-white flame at the target to inflict a burn.
WILLOWISP.name: Will-O-Wisp

WINGATTACK.description: The target is struck with large, imposing wings spread wide to inflict damage.
WINGATTACK.name: Wing Attack

WISH.description: One turn after it is used, the target's HP is restored by half of its maximum HP.
WISH.name: Wish

WITHDRAW.description: The user withdraws its body into its hard shell, raising its Defense stat.
WITHDRAW.name: Withdraw

WONDERROOM.description: For five turns, Pokémon's Def and Sp. Def stats are swapped.
WONDERROOM.name: Wonder Room

WOODHAMMER.description: The user slams its body into the target to attack. The user also sustains serious damage.
WOODHAMMER.name: Wood Hammer

WORKUP.description: The user is roused, and its Attack and Sp. Atk stats increase.
WORKUP.name: Work Up

WORRYSEED.description: Plants a seed that causes worry. It prevents sleep by making its Ability Insomnia.
WORRYSEED.name: Worry Seed

WRAP.description: A long body or vines are used to wrap and squeeze the target for four to five turns.
WRAP.name: Wrap

WRINGOUT.description: The user wrings the target. The more HP the target has, the greater this attack's power.
WRINGOUT.name: Wring Out

XSCISSOR.description: The user slashes at the target by crossing its claws as if they were a pair of scissors.
XSCISSOR.name: X-Scissor

YAWN.description: The user lets loose a yawn that lulls the target into falling asleep on the next turn.
YAWN.name: Yawn

ZAPCANNON.description: The user fires an electric blast like a cannon to inflict damage and cause paralysis.
ZAPCANNON.name: Zap Cannon

ZENHEADBUTT.description: The user focuses power to its head and hits the target. It may make the target flinch.
ZENHEADBUTT.name: Zen Headbutt

ZINGZAP.description: A strong electric blast crashes down on the target. This may also make the target flinch.
ZINGZAP.name: Zing Zap
